title: Alphabetical names
description: Return employee names in alphabetical order.
expected_query: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY name;

title: Salary ranking
description: Return each employee's name and salary, highest salary first.
expected_query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC;

title: Products by category then price
description: Return name, category and price of all products, sorted by category A to Z, then by price from highest to lowest.
expected_query: SELECT name, category, price FROM products ORDER BY category ASC, price DESC;

title: Top three earners
description: Return the name and salary of the three highest-paid employees, highest first.
expected_query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3;
